WITH _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner.`orders___customers___region_id` AS `customers__region_id`,
    _stage_inner.`orders___amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id` AS `amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.region_id AS `orders___customers___region_id`,
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id`
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    GROUP BY
      customers.region_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  orders.region AS `orders___region`,
  CASE
    WHEN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id.`amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id` > 10000
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS `orders___band`,
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___s`
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id
  ON customers.region_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id.`customers__region_id`
GROUP BY
  orders.region,
  CASE
    WHEN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id.`amount_sum_partition_by_customers_region_id` > 10000
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
